trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Buxar in Maintenance Case No. 128 of 2014
case_name: Krishan Behari Pandey vs State Of Bihar & Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Bihar & Khushbu Pandey @ Gudiya D/o Shri Vishwanath Pandey

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks quashing of order directing him to pay Rs. 2500/- per month as ad interim maintenance and Rs. 4000/- as one time cost of litigation. Petitioner's wife has filed a criminal case against him for alleged physical and mental cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse is not entitled to maintenance if they are unwilling to reside with the other spouse.
legal_principles.held: The case of the petitioner is that he is willing to keep his wife and for the said purpose he has also filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal life, but his wife is adamant not to reside with him and, thus, she is not entitled to any maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse's refusal to reside with the other spouse can be a ground for denying maintenance.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner has not disputed the marriage with the opposite party no. 2. The case of the petitioner is that he is willing to keep his wife and for the said purpose he has also filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal life, but his wife is adamant not to reside with him.

outcome.final_order: Order quashed, petitioner directed to pay Rs. 2500/- per month as ad interim maintenance and Rs. 4000/- as one time cost of litigation
